The north star: the Ten-Minute Test
A sceptical stranger with ten minutes should be able to:
1. clone the repository and get green checks;
2. reproduce a published number of their choosing, change an assumption, and see why the result moves;
3. see the latest change with who built it, who checked it and what it cost;
4. read the float figures, each with its basis, and what would move them.
The target is a nightly run that does all four from a clean environment and publishes the result.
Step 1 can be run by hand: tools/stranger_[link] clones a commit, clears the environment and runs the main make check gates.
Step 3 is the public work log at [link]

Follow the load: the sky dishes each half-metre panel of film inward, and the panel hands its pull to the rings it lies on; the rings turn roughly seventy thousand small pulls into one great hoop of compression around the barrel; the webs carry shear between the walls; the inner wall's longerons carry the caps' whole thrust down the length.

One cycle, end to end
The characteristic wildfire mission is one loop of that budget:
Figure 1 The mission cycle: six phases. The hose rides the approaches, and the site is pure pumping.
Figure 1 The mission cycle: six phases. The hose rides the approaches, and the site is pure pumping.

The mission cycle drawn as a loop of six phases: a flown final approach with the hose paying out, pure pumping at the water, an outbound leg that winds the hose up while climbing and lets down on arrival, the drop run along the fire, the escape climb the drop itself powers, and a return that makes nitrogen ballast while descending to hose range.
Three levers work together.
The ballast system has one job: add tonnes the Mind can dial, aboard a vehicle that is mostly made of nothing.
Buying mass there spends the one budget the project cannot spare.

entries.text: Liquid air is the tempting one.
But liquid air is about 21% oxygen, and it does not stay 21%.
But liquid air is about 21% oxygen, and it does not stay 21%.
Nitrogen boils at 77 K, oxygen at 90 K, so a standing tank boils its nitrogen off first and the liquid that remains enriches toward liquid oxygen.
Nitrogen boils at 77 K, oxygen at 90 K, so a standing tank boils its nitrogen off first and the liquid that remains enriches toward liquid oxygen.
Nitrogen boils at 77 K, oxygen at 90 K, so a standing tank boils its nitrogen off first and the liquid that remains enriches toward liquid oxygen.
Aboard this vehicle that property is disqualifying three times over:
Venting an oxygen-enriching liquid over the one thing the mission exists to smother is not a failure mode anyone should have to analyse.
Nitrogen is the boring four-fifths of every breath the intake takes.

The modest discount liquid air offers is the price of not flying a slowly concentrating oxidizer through a fire in a flammable airframe — a bad trade at any efficiency. (Argon would be denser ballast still, and just as inert, but air offers only one percent of it; nitrogen is what the sky actually stocks.)

The first generation, kept for the comparison: a lifting volume filled end to end with printed, independently sealed vacuum voids. The current design keeps the vacuum and gives up the filling twice over. A deep two-walled truss with nothing in the middle is wrapped in ONE membrane laid on hoop rings and pressed on by the atmosphere. Breach containment is compartment membranes across the void. No drawn hull floats. The ship comparison states both bases and altitudes, the unresolved cap accounting and the tests still needed. The newer structural drawing puts machinery on a raft outside the vacuum, with solar panels above and rotors on pylons. Compartment membranes are intended to limit damage; their arrangement remains open. The structural research this rests on is cited on the research page.

Drop-line targeting scores candidate lines using available wind, satellite detections and community proximity, then favours adjacent lines. The model's city list is the population proxy; parcel-level values-at-risk data would refine it. No line repeats until the plan has been treated once. First-order triage, not fire science. Source selection is a size-weighted choice among definite water bodies meeting the class's area and distance rules, larger water preferred over just-qualifying. Fleet allocation scores eligible fires by size, class fit and source distance. Also computed are routes, phase durations, pump and drag and descent power, nitrogen mass-energy cycling, and throughput. The arithmetic section explains selected formulas. The shared model holds the full configuration.

The entire fleet: every airship, route, phase, tank level and delivery figure. No vehicle exists. The research the structural concept leans on, NASA Ames / MIT lattice vacuum airships and the 2021 Akhmeteli–Gavrilin shell analysis, is cited in full on the research page.
The first physical gate is the sealed bench article A, intended to test joints, films, seals and a months-long vacuum hold.

This invented scene describes no real fire. 32-vertex radial polygons at >=80 ha, a seeded sinusoidal perturbation scaled to the drawn area in a local kilometre plane; otherwise the model uses its area-equivalent circle. Rounded to six decimal degrees. All footprints are inside the bundled BC outline and outside bundled water (unoutlined lakes conservatively use area-equivalent discs). Terrain is the bundled hillshade, not a measured height field. Conservative minimum clearances from the whole exercise footprint to discs enclosing every observation and every captured outline of the season's wildfires of note and of every fire in the season evacuation record, on every captured date. Fires on neither list reject nothing: the nearest captured outline of one is 3.1 km from an exercise footprint (nearestOtherFire). Communities are exactly sim/[link], not a complete settlement inventory. Still air; no invented forecast.

Raw checks use exactly that record; extra captures are reported and ignored, while missing or changed named captures fail. Regeneration without --check deliberately adopts all eligible captures. python3 pipeline/[link] --check rebuilds everything that can be rebuilt from committed files and compares bytes. Modifications: the incidents layer is reduced to sixteen fields per fire and sorted by fire-number sequence; epoch-millisecond dates are converted to America/Vancouver calendar dates; 10 fires carrying an impossible date are flagged, kept and counted, and left off the day-by-day timeline unless a stated rule places them (2 placed, 8 not); a capture day is filtered to status not Out and its perimeters generalised to 0.002 degrees and 4 decimal places; a snapshot day is reduced to the mirror's property names; a mirror-history day is unmodified. The season file is hindsight and must never be an input to the dispatch model; the status days are what was known on each day. The Information was modified. The only open-access measurement found of gas flow through as-printed FDM walls, and the basis for this project's position that the printed strut is structure, not the vacuum barrier. Caveats that ride on every number taken from it: the test articles are PLA printed through a 0.30 mm nozzle (not CF-nylon through 0.6 mm); the sealing test is a bubble/volumetric test at about 0.5 bar overpressure, sensitive to roughly mL/s flows - 9-10 orders of magnitude coarser than a vacuum leak budget in the 1e-5 mbar.L/s class, so 'completely blocked' in this paper does not mean vacuum-tight; the k = 0.98 threshold and the wall-thickness series (~0.5 mm perimeter-only walls often untenable at any k; >= 1.1 mm walls seal via a homogeneous inner layer) are from one lab, one printer, one slicer. Caveats that ride on every number taken from it: the test articles are PLA printed through a 0.30 mm nozzle (not CF-nylon through 0.6 mm); the sealing test is a bubble/volumetric test at about 0.5 bar overpressure, sensitive to roughly mL/s flows - 9-10 orders of magnitude coarser than a vacuum leak budget in the 1e-5 mbar.L/s class, so 'completely blocked' in this paper does not mean vacuum-tight; the k = 0.98 threshold and the wall-thickness series (~0.5 mm perimeter-only walls often untenable at any k; >= 1.1 mm walls seal via a homogeneous inner layer) are from one lab, one printer, one slicer. The divisor is the φ in σ = 3p/φ, so it counts the octet lattice's own strut-lengths per Kelvin-cell volume: the lattice is FCC at half-pitch, so it runs three struts per cubic half-pitch, and a cell of span four half-pitches encloses 32 of those — 3 × 32 = 96, exactly. (Clip the infinite lattice against the cell and the measure is 102 strut-lengths, of which the 6 lying in the six square faces belong equally to the cell above: 96 again.) Putting 144 there would dilute the octet's stress with members that are not in the octet, and this article's numbers would stop agreeing with the array's — the one thing the demonstrator exists to prove.
